meta.name: product-launch-video
meta.description: Turn a product or marketing URL, pasted script, or brief into a product launch / promo video — SaaS promos, feature reveals, product demos, app and company launches. Use when the user wants to market, launch, promote, or reveal a product; the default for any commercial URL. Site tours / showcases of a website route here too — the brief carries the show-it-as-is intent. Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把产品链接、脚本或简介生成产品发布与宣传视频
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果手头有产品链接或营销文案,想快速做出发布宣传视频。
copy.tagline_en: Turn a product link, script, or brief into a launch promo video
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have a product link or brief and need a launch video fast.

howto.what: 把一个产品网址、粘贴的脚本或 brief 做成发布/宣传视频:抓取站点素材和品牌色、选定设计预设、写出分镜与脚本、逐帧生成画面,最后渲染成 renders/video.mp4。
howto.when: 当你说想推广、发布或揭晓某个产品时触发;任何商业网址默认走这里,网站导览与展示也归此。意图不明时先读 /hyperframes。

say.text: 用这个网址做一支产品发布视频:https://acme.com
say.note: 抓取站点素材并逐步产出分镜、脚本、画面

say.text: 按我粘贴的这段脚本做宣传片,旁白照原词念
把我们官网做成一段带滚动展示的介绍视频
say.note: 按网站导览处理,截图作为画面素材

howto.what_en: Turns a product or marketing URL, pasted script, or brief into a launch/promo video: captures site assets and brand colors, picks a design preset, writes storyboard and script, builds frames, renders renders/video.mp4.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you want to market, launch, promote, or reveal a product; the default for any commercial URL, and site tours or showcases route here too. Unclear intent goes to /hyperframes first.

say_en.text: Make a product launch video from this URL: https://acme.com
say_en.note: Captures the site, then drafts storyboard, script, frames

say_en.text: Turn this pasted script into a promo, keep the voiceover verbatim
say_en.note: Saves script as user_script.txt, VO_MODE verbatim

say_en.text: Make our website into an intro video with a scroll shot
say_en.note: Treated as a site tour; screenshots become visuals
